desc: Derive and verify the O(N log N) formula (potential Φ / leftmost-inversion greedy) for the minimum cost.

Implement and validate the final Python solution: use a Fenwick tree to compute r = count of previous values < P_i for each 1-indexed position i, accumulate ans += (i-1)*i//2 - r*(r+1)//2, update the tree, and print ans; before finalizing, cross-check the formula against brute-force Dijkstra for all permutations up to N=6 and edge cases (sorted, reverse, N=2).
